canonical_title: Cooling test procedures for reciprocating engine-powered aeroplanes

versions.title_at_revision: Cooling test procedures for reciprocating engine-powered aeroplanes
versions.text: Compliance with CS 23.1041 must be shown for the climb (or descent, for twin-engined aeroplanes with negative one-engine-inoperative rates of climb) stage of flight. The aeroplane must be flown in the configurations, at the speeds and following the procedures recommended in the aeroplane flight manual, corresponding to the applicable performance requirements, which are critical relative to cooling.
